rss_gate.method: Round1 warms caches. Compare the same persistent server's RSS immediately after the final round against immediately after round1; all rounds remain correctness/throughput samples. This is a short phase4 observation, not the final24-hour soak.

verification_scope: Exact binary-body samples before/after fixed-count h2load; every h2load request/status and aggregate data count checked. h2load does not validate each body's contents. Short RSS samples are not the final soak.
